connector.name: rustunnel
connector.registryDescription: Give AI agents public HTTPS/TCP/UDP URLs for any localhost service. Open source, self-hostable.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the desktop bundle rustunnel-mcp-aarch64-apple-darwin.mcpb. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the joaoh82 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
